records.literal_text:
Verses not traceable in Vedic Concordance; either late forgery or from [overwritten: an unpublished?] Brāhmaṇa. Begins: Vṛṣā kar-
vi(sic) kulaṁ ha vai Śibikulaṁ babhūva | tasyāyam itihāsaḥ kulavidyā babhūva.
ff.1-3, verses 1-35, called Pitṛsūkta in col., ff 4-5 verses 47-70 without col., a collection of mantras used at funeral
   ceremonies.

fields.title: Pitṛsūkta
fields.incipit: Vṛṣā kar-vi(sic) kulaṁ ha vai Śibikulaṁ babhūva | tasyāyam itihāsaḥ kulavidyā babhūva.

annotations: Four lines of cursive ink across the lower part of the page, at about y 3225–3465.
The words near 'an unpublished' in line 1 are heavily overwritten or re-inked; the underlying reading is unresolved.
Small commas are added below the line in line 3, after '1-35' and after 'col.'.
Two arrows on the facing fol. 143, to the right of the gutter, point from this note's line ends toward the entries d.13(3) and d.13(4).

editorial_context.evidence: Arrows at the line ends of this note point to the Pitṛsūkta entries d.13(3) and d.13(4) on fol. 143.

relationships.evidence: An arrow on fol. 143 runs beside line 1 of this note toward d.13(3). The extent 'ff.1-3' and the title 'Pitṛsūkta' match that entry.
A second arrow on fol. 143 runs beside line 3 of this note toward d.13(4). The 'ff 4-5 verses 47-70 without col.' portion may describe it.

uncertainties: The overwritten word(s) in line 1 near 'an unpublished' are unresolved.
The readings of the cursive transliteration are tentative, especially 'kulaṁ', 'ha vai', 'tasyāyam', 'kulavidyā' and both instances of 'babhūva'.
The division of the note between d.13(3) and d.13(4) is not certain.

block_disposition.explanation: A single continuous descriptive note transcribed as one continuation note, possibly attached to entries on fol. 143.

page_annotations: Apart from b001 and b002, the ruled page is blank on image review.
There is an isolated ink stroke resembling 'j' or 'i' in the left margin at about [395,1785,60,115]. It is probably a stray mark or blot; no text is recorded.
Very faint dotted marks near the top, at about [880,560,1000,70], are probably offset or show-through and are illegible.
There is a small ink dot near the right edge at about [3020,1660].
The facing fol. 143 is visible to the right of the gutter (x≈3114). It is context only and is not transcribed here.
unresolved_relationships: The precise attachment of r002 to d.13(3) and/or d.13(4) on fol. 143 is not confirmed beyond the arrows and the matching extent.

coverage.finding: The top-left page number reads '142' with a raised 'b'. It is correctly recorded as a page label.

All four lines are present: line 1 from 'Verses not' to 'kar-', line 2 from 'vi(sic)' to 'babhūva.', line 3 from 'ff.1-3' to 'funeral', and the indented line 4 'ceremonies.'. The overlapping tiles add no duplicated text. Three items need correction. The literal text puts description inside brackets ('overwritten:'). The arrow direction is misdescribed: on fol. 143 the arrowheads point left, toward this note. 'Pitṛsūkta' is a title cited from the colophon, but it is filed as fields.title.
